channel.description: Latest articles from Paste Media Group (pastemagazine.com)

item.title: It's Sinners versus everybody else in the latest stack of anonymous Oscar ballots
item.description: Ryan Coogler's film seems to be the movie that people are either voting for, or against, in the latest report on nameless Oscar ballots.

item.title: Quentin Tarantino puts off 10th movie to develop British farce for the stage
item.description: After gifting his 10th and final film to David Fincher, Quentin Tarantino is trading the big screen for the stage floor.

item.title: Disney has quietly dumped its live-action-but-he's-still-a-sexy-fox Robin Hood plans
item.description: Raya And The Last Dragon director Carlos López Estrada has revealed that his Robin Hood revival plans are dead at Disney.

item.title: It's Ben Stiller's turn to be mad about getting turned into deliberately dumb White House propaganda
item.description: Stiller was not happy about seeing 2008's Tropic Thunder in the White House's latest assault on good taste, writing, "War is not a movie."

item.title: Pixar's sequel addiction has spread to a Monsters Inc. 3
item.description: It's been 13 years, and one since-ended streaming show, since Monsters University, but Pixar's revving up for another sequel.

item.title: Neko Case swam with Moby Dick in the fables of Fox Confessor Brings the Flood
item.description: Time Capsule: On this day in 2006, the New Pornographers vocalist crafted not just a set of bewitching, alluring Grimms’ fairytales, but the best solo album of her career.

item.title: R.I.P. Stephen Hibbert, It's Pat screenwriter and Pulp Fiction's "The Gimp"
item.description: Hibbert secured his most famous role after meeting Quentin Tarantino while performing at famed L.A. improv comedy theater The Groundlings.
